title: Repair the seen notebook

tests.expr: (x := lit(5), a := Node('add', [x, lit(1)]), count_boxes(Node('mul', [a, x])))[-1]

hints: The walk looks in `seen` before it goes inside a box. Does anything ever get written into `seen`?
A box has to go into the notebook the first time the walk goes inside it, before the walk moves on to its sources.
Add one line right after the `if`: `seen.add(id(n))`.
explain: The walk checked the notebook but never wrote in it, so every check said "new" and the shared boxes were walked once per arrow: 15 times for `chain(3)`. Writing `id(n)` into `seen` the first time a box is entered makes every later arrival stop at the check, so each box is entered once. `id(n)` names the object itself, so two separate boxes that look alike still count as two.
